components.name: Capture FAB
components.description: The one round element: always-visible memory capture, bottom-right.
components.css: .ds-fab { display: grid; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--paper); background: var(--theme-ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-fab:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 1rem var(--font-body); border: 1px solid var(--theme-ink); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem; color: var(--theme-ink); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink-tint); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Cabinet Red outline reserved for permanent deletion.

components.name: Floating Chip
components.description: Floating canvas/account action; Browse uses the inked pressed state.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip ds-mode" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Browse</button> <button class="ds-chip" type="button">Archive · 3</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink-tint); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-chip:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-mode { min-height: 44px; } .ds-mode[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--paper); background: var(--theme-ink); } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-chip { padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem; } } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; } }

components.css: .ds-slip { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 320px; min-height: 180px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem 1rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); cursor: grab; } .ds-slip-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.1rem 0.5rem; } .ds-slip-kind { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin-bottom: 0.45rem; color: var(--theme-ink); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-slip-meta { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0 0 0.15rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--muted); } .ds-slip-meta time { letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-slip-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-slip-edit { border: 0; padding: 0.15rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--theme-ink); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slip-edit:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slip-body { overflow: hidden; } .ds-slip-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; margin: 0.6rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-slip-tag { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.4; text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-slip-primary { color: var(--paper); background: var(--tag-color); } .ds-slip-topic { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--topic-color) 55%, var(--paper)); color: var(--topic-color); background: var(--paper); } .ds-slip { font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-slip-body p { margin: 0.55rem 0; } .ds-slip-edit:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Drawer Index
components.description: Static minimap preview; in the app, clicking the Svelte Flow minimap centers the board.
components.css: .ds-minimap { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: 220px; height: 160px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slip); } .ds-minimap-card { position: absolute; display: flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 35%, var(--paper)); } .ds-minimap-card i { flex: 1; } .ds-minimap-card-a { top: 34px; right: 22px; width: 42px; height: 26px; } .ds-minimap-card-a i:first-child { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 305); } .ds-minimap-card-a i:last-child { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 145); } .ds-minimap-card-b { bottom: 18px; left: 78px; width: 50px; height: 28px; } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(1) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 145); } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(2) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 255); } .ds-minimap-card-b i:nth-child(3) { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 305); } .ds-minimap-mask { position: absolute; inset: 20px 14px 36px 22px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--theme-ink) 12%, transparent); } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-minimap { width: 8.5rem; height: 6.5rem; } }

narrative.overview:
The app is a natural-history drawer: the pile is a curated collection, and every
memory is a cataloged specimen slip on an archival sheet. The register is
museum-modern — hairline rules, typed catalog labels, near-black ink, one quiet
accent — never scrapbook-nostalgic (no washi tape, cork, or sentimentality) and
never productivity-SaaS (no topbar chrome, no dot grid, no blue).

Confirmed anti-references: productivity SaaS, cute/nostalgic scrapbook, dark
mode cave, anything that slows capture.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas-first: the canvas is the app; there is no topbar, only floating controls.
Cards are neutral archival slips; tag color lives on labels, not on card fills.
One theme ink derives the entire UI palette via CSS `color-mix`.
Typed mono labels carry metadata; a grotesque carries reading text.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every chrome color derives from `--theme-ink` by `color-mix`; no second accent hue enters the interface chrome. (Tag colors and the semantic red are meaning, not chrome.)

rules.name: The Color-on-Labels Rule
rules.body: Tag color appears on labels, chips, and the minimap index — never as a full card background fill.

rules.name: The Typed Label Rule
rules.body: Metadata is set in the mono face like a catalog entry; prose is set in the grotesque. The mono is used for code as well as labels, never for prose, and the grotesque is never tracked out like a label.

dos: **Do** derive every chrome color from `--theme-ink` via `color-mix`.
**Do** keep cards neutral; express tag identity through label color and the minimap split.
**Do** keep capture one click away on the canvas at all times.
**Do** set metadata in the typed mono face at small sizes (0.64–0.68rem).
**Do** preserve the persisted viewport; the owner returns to their spot.
donts: **Don't** fill card backgrounds with tag colors (the sticky-note look).
**Don't** add a topbar, sidebar, or any persistent chrome band.
**Don't** use pill radii, dot grids, or a second accent hue in the chrome.
**Don't** add a dark mode; the scene is a desk in daylight.
**Don't** animate canvas content or add hover effects to slips; motion   belongs to dialog entrances only.
